benchmark: SWE-bench Verified Easy-50: baseline horizon-limit failures
selection_rule: Every unresolved admitted seed-0 no-PRA Easy-50 task whose recorded termination_reason is LimitsExceeded; fixed before longer-horizon outcomes are observed.

horizon_ladder.gate: official resolution or a nonempty source-only patch with forward progress

horizon_ladder.eligibility: only identities with forward progress at 80 calls

guardrails: The original 14/50 success denominator remains unchanged.
A longer-horizon success is a separately declared capability cohort, not retrospective enlargement of Easy-14.
Run FULL before any history policy; an unresolved FULL task cannot be counted as a policy failure.
Report extra calls and cumulative token cost alongside any added solves.
